context: A modal dialog drawn over a styled full screen view

checklist.name: overlay_preserves_ansi
checklist.description: Composes the dialog over the pane with Lip Gloss layers (`NewLayer`, `NewCompositor`, `Render`) or an ANSI aware cut of each background line (for example `ansi.Truncate` or `ansi.Cut`), never by slicing rendered strings by byte or rune index, which cuts through escape sequences and shifts the columns.

checklist.name: hit_test
checklist.description: Decides inside or outside from the dialog's actual placement, for example `Compositor.Hit(x, y)` or the same offsets used to position the dialog, rather than hard coded coordinates.

checklist.name: mouse_via_view
checklist.description: Enables mouse reporting with the `MouseMode` field on the returned `tea.View` (v2 has no `WithMouseCellMotion` option) and handles `tea.MouseClickMsg`.

checklist.name: background_via_message
checklist.description: Detects light or dark with `tea.RequestBackgroundColor` and `tea.BackgroundColorMsg`; does not call `lipgloss.HasDarkBackground` on the terminal while the program runs.
